evidence: One hidden timing/control demand found in cw_restore_retry. Frozen task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:470 says to abort only one response delivery, then "The UI must offer a way to retry the same attempt ... Invoke that action"; task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:532 expressly requires "The actual UI retry after a controlled lost reply". Public task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:38 requires same-attempt retry returning the original result, including after newer work, but never forbids automatic recovery or requires an unresolved/manual-retry state after exactly one lost reply. policy.md:5 and ui.md:7 leave controls/placement open. A robust bounded automatic retry followed by manual fallback is therefore needlessly excluded by this exact probe. The remainder of the reverse map is supported: S02-S04 and S09-S13/S36 map to behaviour.md:5-15 (including current typed/interactive picture and static rollback); S05/S07/S08 map to security.md:3-9 and policy.md:5; console/Auto-run map to behaviour.md:19-21; S19 maps to ui.md:5; S21/S23 map to behaviour.md:25-29 and security.md:11; S37/S38 snapshot, inspection, restore, stale protection and races map to behaviour.md:34-40; S22 record/history/retry restart maps to integration.md:9 and behaviour.md:40. Render and Constraints use the expressly required manual Run, shared library and /api/health. Polish/Visual stay within ui.md:3-9 and professional legibility defaults, accept native styling, standard editor escape, one theme and flexible layout. No exact route, numbering base, numeric +1, extra file type, private execution-realm proof or live restored handlers is demanded. Adversarial reasoning: a backend-idempotent app whose user Retry creates a new attempt could pass the request-replay-only step 5, so keeping a real lost-reply UI/client-path check is warranted; step 5a correctly exposes that broken behavior. Rebuilding source instead of preserving edited preview state is likewise legitimately rejected by S10 at prompt.md:273-285. The defect is the narrower post-one-loss manual-action requirement, not retry or stateful rollback itself. All 21 raw-index artifact hashes matched. The specific scripted golden lost-reply observation records committed revision 6 and retry revision 6, and late replay returns revision 4 while newer head is revision 5. That supports the golden manual path but does not exercise the conforming automatic-retry alternative or refute this fairness counterexample. No configured judge, portal, Oracle or target-model score was run or inferred.
counterexample: A conforming app assigns a persistent attempt ID to Restore, commits it transactionally with immutable history, and on fetch failure automatically retries that exact logical attempt once. If the retry also fails, it retains the attempt and exposes a keyboard-accessible Retry action. Every duplicate returns the original result even after a later Save/restart. Under S37 step 5a, the first committed response alone is aborted; its automatic retry immediately receives the original result, the UI shows confirmed success, and there is no unresolved action for the judge to invoke. The user loses nothing, gets exactly one new revision and retains manual retry for unresolved failures, yet the mandatory actual user-invoked retry after this single-loss setup has no observation and cw_restore_retry cannot meet its full-credit bar. This is a source-level counterexample, not an executed alternative-app or measured judge result.
suggested_fix: Accept observed automatic same-attempt recovery after the controlled loss with the same original-result/no-extra-history checks; exercise an explicit Retry action when an unresolved outcome remains, without requiring a particular manual state after exactly one lost response.
